run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th element from sequence a missing from sequence b
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print success count results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use binary search instead of linear scan for better performance
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts elements in a not present in b and returns the k-th
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty sequences or k exceeding missing element count
